answer: One defense is a stake bond with slashing. An agent locks 500 tokens before it may trade, then earns a trust score by completing verified jobs over 30 days. Any peer can challenge a suspicious identity with evidence, and established agents vote; a guilty verdict burns half the bond and bans the identity, while a false challenge costs the challenger 50 tokens. Forging 1,000 sybils ties up 500,000 tokens plus $12,000 in fees, and each ban sends a ripple through the market. A sybil ring is like a jade carving sold as a relic: pretty at first glance, worthless once the bond test exposes it.
